feed.title: {genre} edits
feed.forYouHelp: Editing references from categories you’ve explored. Your saved ideas and feedback help shape this selection.
feed.chooseCategoryHelp: Open a category to find more references. This feed uses posts already found, without running another search.
feed.inspirationHelp: Editing references chosen for technique and relevance. Preview them to judge the edit.
feed.popularHelp: Recent examples with substantial engagement checked on the source. Popularity alone does not prove a trend or a great edit.
feed.popularPolicy: Posted within 30 days; counts checked within 3 days. Instagram uses likes when available, TikTok and YouTube use views. The minimum selected count is 1,000 likes or 25,000 views on Instagram / TikTok, and 250 likes or 10,000 views on YouTube. These are selection rules, not a score for editing quality.
feed.learningHelp: Tutorials and breakdowns that describe teaching the technique. Useful lessons do not need lots of likes.
feed.exploreHelp: Wider matches, including smaller creators and posts with limited evidence. These are leads to explore.
feed.empty: No edits meet this feed’s requirements yet.
feed.emptyPopular: No recent examples have enough checked engagement for this feed yet.
feed.emptyLearning: No clear lessons found yet. Tutorial announcements and requests do not count as lessons.
feed.shortage: A small selection is all we can support so far. We won’t fill it with unrelated videos.
feed.searchCost: Up to {n} platform lookups; credit costs vary.
feed.findMoreHelp: Search for another small batch. Changing modes or feedback does not run a search.
feed.noMore: No more searches are available for this feed right now.
feed.localOnly: Saved on this device. This does not change your Instagram or TikTok feed.
feed.moreSaved: You’ll see more similar techniques here.
feed.creatorHidden: This creator is hidden from your feed.
feed.sourceRead: Post details checked. The footage has not been reviewed.
feed.indexed: Suggested by search text. It may not describe the video accurately.
feed.noEvidence: Limited details available. Preview it before using it as a reference.
feed.personal: Your saved references or feedback influenced this recommendation.
feed.searchPartial: {platform}: only part of the search completed ({n} posts returned).
feed.searchAuth: The search provider refused the key.
feed.searchUpstream: The search service did not respond.
feed.searchFiltered: These totals are before feed filters.
feed.refillHelp: Search all dates for useful examples and lessons. Reuses a saved search when available; otherwise starts a new lookup.
feed.refillCost: Up to {web} web lookups + {youtube} YouTube searches; credit costs vary.
feed.quotaHelp: The last live search reached this source’s allowance. Choose another available platform; saved searches may still work below.
feed.referenceHelp: Bring a post you found in your own feed. This saves a personal reference without a paid search; public post details may be checked.
feed.referenceUrl: Instagram, TikTok or YouTube post link
feed.referenceKeep: Keep in my inspiration — my personal selection, not verified trend evidence.
feed.referenceInvalid: Paste a full Instagram reel, TikTok video or YouTube video link.
feed.referenceNoteFull: Your existing saved note has no room for this addition. Open Saved to edit it first.
feed.personalUnverified: Chosen by you. The video’s content and popularity are unverified.
